source: Huang, Ramesh, Berg and Learned-Miller (2007), UMass Amherst Technical Report 07-49; Huang and Learned-Miller (2014), UMass Amherst Technical Report UM-CS-2014-003
view1: development only: pairsDevTrain (1100 genuine + 1100 impostor) and pairsDevTest (500 + 500)
view2: reporting only: 10 folds, each 300 genuine + 300 impostor; results reported as mean over folds
declared_training_paradigm: Unrestricted, labeled outside data (pretrained ArcFace/FaceNet in Phase 2)
project_rules: No model is tuned, selected or thresholded on View 2.
Yoking categories are frozen here, before any matcher score exists.
Pairs that do not resolve to master rows are kept and flagged, not dropped.
